name: fld_card_four_sq_add_self_add_one
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (h : Fintype.card K = 4) (x : K) (h0 : x ≠ 0) (h1 : x ≠ 1) : x ^ 2 + x + 1 = 0
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (h : Fintype.card K = 4) (x : K) (h0 : x ≠ 0) (h1 : x ≠ 1), x ^ 2 + x + 1 = 0
informal: In a field with 4 elements every element other than 0, 1 is a root of X^2 + X + 1 — x^3 = 1 by FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one, so (x - 1)(x^2 + x + 1) = 0 and x ≠ 1.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype K], Fintype.card K = 4 → ∀ (x : K), x ≠ 0 → x ≠ 1 → x ^ 2 + x + 1 = 0
